methods.name: Quest skip to level 30
methods.note: The Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, Recruitment Drive and Holy Grail give 14,531 XP for 30, or 31 with The Ides of Milk lamp. The ironman guide's nine quests reach 37.

methods.name: Gilded altar, dragon bones
methods.note: Both burners lit for 350% XP, about 2,550 bones an hour clicking each bone. Use a host's altar at Rimmington and unnote at Phials, or your own at 75 Construction.

methods.name: Gilded altar, your own bones
methods.note: Ironmen cannot use other players' altars. Dragon bones with both burners lit give 252 XP each, half the chaos altar's. Bank at the Camelot chest on a PvP world.

methods.name: Chaos altar, dragon bones
methods.note: Level 38 Wilderness. 350% XP and half the bones spared, so 504 XP a dragon bone, the most of any method. Rate is one inventory a trip, then dying. Noted bones go faster.

methods.name: Ensouled hellhound heads
methods.note: Expert Reanimation at the Dark Altar, about 190 heads an hour. Hellhound heads need no Slayer level; bloodveld heads give 1,040 and need 50 Slayer. Heads trade thinly.

methods.name: Ensouled dragon heads
methods.note: Master Reanimation by the Dark Altar, about 190 heads an hour with good combat stats. Bring dragonfire protection. Less effort than an altar and no Wilderness.

methods.name: Ectofuntus
methods.note: 400% XP per bone but slow: grind the bones, fill slime, worship, about 180 an hour teleporting to bank. The ectophial from Ghosts Ahoy helps. Safe for hardcore ironmen.

methods.name: Sinister Offering, dragon bones
methods.note: Arceuus spell offering three bones a cast for 300% XP, a cast every 5.4 seconds, and 108k Magic XP an hour. A blood and a wrath rune a cast; ironmen need 95 Runecraft.

methods.name: Cremating urium remains
methods.note: Shades of Mort'ton with redwood pyre logs, about 300 an hour. A loss at current prices, but the fastest way to zealot's robes. Up to 57k with the hard Morytania diary.

methods.name: Gilded altar, dagannoth bones
methods.note: The fastest bones until superior dragon bones at 70: 437.5 XP each with both burners lit, about 2,550 an hour clicking each bone. Twice the coins an XP of dragon bones.

methods.name: Gilded altar, dragon bones with auto-offering
methods.note: Use one bone on the altar and it offers the rest by itself, about 1,070 bones an hour. Under half the XP of clicking each bone, for far less clicking.

methods.name: Pest Control points
methods.note: Spend commendation points 100 at a time on Prayer XP: about 24 veteran games an hour at 5 points. Each combat achievement tier up to hard adds a point a game.

methods.name: Libation bowl, dragon bones to shards
methods.note: The Teomat. Bless and chisel dragon bones, then offer the shards with sunfire wine: about 1,700 bones an hour all in, 348 XP a bone. Other shards go twice as fast.

methods.name: Gilded altar, superior dragon bones
methods.note: Same method with superior dragon bones, which need 70 Prayer. The fastest Prayer XP without Wilderness risk and the most expensive.

methods.name: Chaos altar, superior dragon bones
methods.note: Same altar with superior dragon bones, 1,050 XP a bone on average. Rate is one inventory a trip, then dying. Up to 1.8m bringing noted bones, risking them to PKers.

unverified: Quest skip to level 30: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0); the four quests give 14,531.5 XP (Recruitment Drive pays 1,000.5), level 30, and 31 with the 1,000 XP lamp of The Ides of Milk; His Faithful Servants (20,000, all six Barrows brothers) would take the four to 39

Gilded altar, dragon, dagannoth and superior dragon bones: 2,550 bones an hour is the guide's figure 'with good banking and accurate clicks', which it sets below 'up to 3,500' with alts, so 85% was not applied; at a tick a bone by hand that leaves about 20 seconds a trip for teleports and banking, where Jagex's 2017 blog implies about 40 seconds for an average player, so ordinary play may be nearer 1,700 to 2,000 bones; a main without 75 Construction uses a host's altar, which req cannot express

Gilded altar, dagannoth bones: 1,115,625 is the guide's comparison table (2,550 bones of 437.5 XP); it is here because the app counts a main on any budget as buying superior dragon bones at 40 coins an XP from 70, and dagannoth bones (30 coins an XP, dragon bones 15) are the fastest bones that trade in quantity before 70, as in Wise Old Man's main table; hydra and frost dragon bones (981,750 and 892,500) sit between the two at about 20 coins an XP; ourg bones (140 XP) trade in tens a day
Gilded altar, dragon bones with auto-offering: the guide's 'only up to 1,070 bones per hour' and Jagex's 2017 'around 270k' for 40 trips an hour agree within 1%, so 85% was not applied

Gilded altar, your own bones: the ironman guide gives no rate, so the main guide's dragon bone figure is used; the guide says lighting a burner needs 30 Firemaking, but no other page (the burner, the chapel, marrentill, the Firemaking level table) gives a level, so req does not ask for it; 75 Construction can be met from 69 with a crystal saw and tea

Chaos altar, dragon bones and superior dragon bones: 428,400 and 892,500 are 85% of the guide's 'up to around 2,000 bones an hour' suiciding after each inventory (500,000 and 1,050,000), because the guide gives 2,000 as a top figure and the ironman guide only says 500,000 'should be possible'; 2,000 needs a quick teleport in and a respawn point near a bank (Ferox Enclave or Edgeville at 5 million coins each, or a PvP world); the Ultimate Ironman guide's slower deathpile routine manages about 1,260 offerings an hour; noted bones give up to 860,000 and 1,800,000 at more risk, and the guide's gravestone warping (12 October 2026) lets a player risk one stack at a time

Libation bowl, dragon bones to shards: 591,600 from 62 is the guide's comparison table (1,700 bones an hour blessed, chiselled and offered with sunfire wine); the guide's own cycle times give 643,000 there, 8% more; the other bands follow those cycle times scaled to the table and agree with the guide's 'about half' of the offering-only rate within 12%; without sunfire wine every figure is a sixth less; the guide's offering-only table is internally inconsistent from 62 (its XP figures do not follow its seconds per run); the 65 seconds the guide allows for each wine trip assume quick travel back to the Teomat (a quetzal after Twilight's Promise, a ring of dueling with Colosseum Hero status, or the rare pendant of Ates), so an account with only Children of the Sun is somewhat slower

Ensouled heads (both): 187 heads an hour is 85% of the guide's 'up to 220' with high combat stats; the Expert entry was 'Ensouled bloodveld heads' and is renamed to hellhound heads (1,200 XP against 1,040, the same spell, no Slayer level where reanimated bloodveld need 50, about the same coins an XP and trade); ensouled dragon heads trade in the low tens of thousands a day and the Expert heads in the low thousands, so a main may have to buy over several days

Ironmen are short of bones rather than time: a dragon bone gives 504 XP at the chaos altar, 348 at the libation bowl with sunfire wine (290 without), 288 at the Ectofuntus, 252 at a gilded altar and 216 by Sinister Offering, but the app ranks methods by XP an hour, so from 30 an ironman with Children of the Sun is pointed at the libation bowl; weighing a method by XP a supply would need a new field across every skill, so the notes give XP a bone instead

Ectofuntus: 51,840 is the Ectofuntus page's 'approximately 180' worships an hour with teleports to bank, at 288 XP a dragon bone; no guide gives a rate; it assumes the ectophial, a Ghosts Ahoy reward, which req does not ask for because the Ectofuntus only needs Morytania

Sinister Offering, dragon bones: 388,800 is the guide's 600 casts an hour, 90% of the 666 the 9-tick cooldown allows; 85% of the cap would be 367,200; ironmen need wrath runes, which in practice means 95 Runecraft, and req cannot ask that of ironmen alone

Cremating urium remains: the minigame needs the quest Shades of Mort'ton; 35,000 is the guide's figure (the money making guide's 300 cremations an hour gives 36,150); the money making guide showed a loss of 882,923 coins an hour on 14 October 2026, which is 24 coins a Prayer XP, so the guide's 'typically profitable' is out of date

Pest Control points: bands are the reward formula (floor(level squared / 600) x 18, plus 10% for 100 points at once) at 5 points a veteran game and the Ultimate Ironman guide's 24 games an hour; the hard combat achievement tier makes it 8 points (38,016 at 78, the ironman guide's 'around 40k' at 80), which req cannot express; points are worth most spent at a high level

Efficiency ceilings (Wise Old Man, 14 October 2026): main 1,670,000 from 0 (dagannoth bones at the chaos altar) and 2,000,000 from 70 (superior dragon bones), above every main rate here; the ironman table's 175,900 counts killing the dragons for the bones, so it is not a ceiling for offering rates, which the app shows to ironmen as 'if supplied'

Not included: hydra or frost dragon bones at a gilded altar (between dragon and dagannoth bones in speed and cost); Demonic Offering (84 Magic, A Kingdom Divided; 594,000 with infernal ashes at 9.7 coins an XP, never faster than a gilded altar for a main); the libation bowl with offering-only rates (shards are untradeable, so making them is part of the training); lower ensouled heads (troll heads 145,860 at 41 Magic); the sacred bone burner (300%, unpopular); burying bones in free-to-play; bonecrusher, ash sanctifier and other by-products (Camdozaal, calcified rocks, Hunters' Rumours, Moons of Peril, bird's eggs, vampyre dust)
